setup: s.level = Math.max(8, s.level); s.dive.opens = [0, 0, 0]; return true;
until: (() => { for (const p of s.people) if (p.status === 'queue' && !p.tubOnly) { s.selected = p.id; s.assign(2); } return s.people.some(p => p.dive === 'air' && p.jump.flail && p.jump.t > p.jump.T * 0.3 && p.jump.t < p.jump.T * 0.5); })()
after: const p = s.people.find(p => p.dive === 'air' && p.jump.flail); return { focus: [p.x, p.y, p.z], y: p.y, j: { o: p.jump.outcome, t: p.jump.t, T: p.jump.T }, type: p.type };
